about_the_game:
Flowtrix: System and Economy Designer

Design. Simulate. Balance.

Flowtrix is a powerful node-based software that lets game developers, designers, and enthusiasts create, test, and fine-tune game economies with unparalleled flexibility. Whether you’re designing a simple in-game shop or a complex multi-currency economy, Flowtrix gives you the tools to simulate every interaction, balance resources, and predict outcomes before writing a single line of code.

Key Features:

  • Node-Based Interface: Intuitive drag-and-drop workflow to design complex game economies visually.

  • Real-Time Simulation: Test and tweak your economy on-the-fly to see immediate results.

  • Customizable Nodes: Build resource nodes, storage nodes, arithmetic nodes, and more to model any system.

  • Dynamic Variables & Conditions: Simulate player behaviors, resource flow, and economic triggers with full control over logic and outcomes.

  • Scalable Design: From small projects to large-scale economies, Flowtrix adapts to any level of complexity.

  • Export & Integrate: Export simulation results in csv and flow charts.

Flowtrix empowers you to prototype, analyze, and perfect your in-game economies, reducing guesswork and ensuring a balanced, engaging experience for players.

Who is it for?

  • Indie game developers who want precise control over their economy.

  • Designers looking to prototype complex resource systems.

  • Students or enthusiasts learning about game design and economic modeling.

Take the guesswork out of game economy design—Flowtrix lets you build, simulate, and perfect with confidence.
